newsitem.title: USA: AMX Corp sees loss for qtr ending March 31.
newsitem.headline: AMX Corp sees loss for qtr ending March 31.

text.p: AMX Corp said it anticipates a loss for the quarter ending March 31 because of litigation settlement with Ford Audio-Video of Oklahoma City and other factors.
The company said it would take a one-time charge of $0.08 per share as a result of the settlement. It said it decided to settle with Ford Audio-Video to avoid defense costs and continued uncertainty.

The company also said that higher-than-expected losses at its PHAST and AudioEase units, as well as expenses incurred with opening a Singapore office and introducing a new line of teleconferencing products, also contributed to the expected quarterly loss.
The loss will come on revenues of $11.5 million, the company said.
AMX expects to release its earnings for the quarter ended March 31 on May 1.
